newsitem.title: USA: MEMC CFO says Q4 prospects unclear.
newsitem.headline: MEMC CFO says Q4 prospects unclear.

text.p: MEMC Electronic Materials Inc's Chief Financial Officer James Stolze Wednesday said the company's fourth quarter prospects are unclear amid bulging customer inventories of silicon wafers.
The maker of wafers -- the sheets of electrical material used to make computer chips -- said its customers are burning off existing inventories before buying more.

"Sales outlook for the fourth quarter is clouded right now," he told investors at the Montgomery Securities investment conference here. He declined to elaborate and declined to comment about fourth quarter financial results.
In September, MEMC said its third quarter sales are expected to be in line with the $289.8 million reported in the first quarter and below its second quarter record sales of $324.3 million.
Shares of the St. Peters, Mo.-based company closed 1/2 higher at 22-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
